video_title: Charlie Villanueva Reveals UNTOLD Stories & Breaks Down The NBA Finals

quotes.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
quotes.summary_phrase: Charlie Villanueva on his emotional reaction to being traded to the Milwaukee Bucks
quotes.excerpt: When I did get traded to Milwaukee, I'm gonna be honest, I was hurt.
quotes.quote: When I did get traded to Milwaukee, I'm gonna be honest, I was hurt. I was hurt because I was so loyal to Toronto because they gave me the opportunity. But at the same time, when I got to Milwaukee, I love the city, I love the fans, I love everything about it, and it ended up being one of the three best years that I had in my career.

quotes.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
quotes.summary_phrase: Charlie Villanueva discusses his 48-point game against the Milwaukee Bucks
quotes.excerpt: It just happened to be the day that UConn went to the final four and played George Mason.
quotes.quote: It's crazy because it was my rookie year with Toronto, and it just happened to be the day that UConn went to the final four and played George Mason. And they ended up losing in the final four to George Mason, which shouldn't have happened, but it happened. And I just remember me being so angry about that. And it was just one of those days where Chris Bosh ended up getting hurt. We just needed scoring, so it was an opportunity. When somebody gets hurt, next man up. And for me at that time, I had it going. It just seemed like my teammates just kept finding me and I kept making the plays.

quotes.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
quotes.summary_phrase: Charlie Villanueva on being ranked behind LeBron James and Luol Deng in high school
quotes.excerpt: LeBron James was ranked number one, Luol Deng was number two and I was number three.
quotes.quote: LeBron James was ranked number one, Luol Deng was number two and I was number three in the country. Me being able to play with Luol on the same team was amazing. I come from Queens, New York, he came from Sudan, a whole another side of the world. We had the similar story, the struggles. We got to earn everything that we have and we won three championships. We both got our jerseys retired in high school, we both made the school Hall of Fame, so it's pretty cool to go through the journey together.

quotes.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
quotes.summary_phrase: Charlie Villanueva on his college recruitment and choosing UConn over Indiana
quotes.excerpt: I verbally committed to Illinois and then coach Bill Self ended up going to Kansas.
quotes.quote: I verbally committed to Illinois and then coach Bill Self ended up going to Kansas. I thought about going to Kansas, but then I ended up picking UConn. And then Luol and I end up playing in the final four against each other, which is crazy. I still talk to him to this day about it. I show him the ring every opportunity I get because I can throw that in his face.

quotes.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
quotes.summary_phrase: Charlie Villanueva on his rivalry with his brother and the Indiana Pacers
quotes.excerpt: Reggie Miller was my favorite player and the reason why I wore 31 was because of Reggie Miller.
quotes.quote: My older brother was always a Knicks fan. For me, I always wanted to go against my brother because we are very competitive. Instead of joining him, I picked at that time, it was the Indiana Pacers. Reggie Miller was my favorite player and the reason why I wore 31 was because of Reggie Miller. One of my favorite players was Reggie Miller, so I always went for Indiana Pacers, so that stood with me forever in the sense of I always want to go against the Knicks.

quotes.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
quotes.summary_phrase: Charlie Villanueva on his dislike for the New York Knicks
quotes.excerpt: I love every New York team except the Knicks.
quotes.quote: I love every New York team except the Knicks. To me, I was like, I'm happy for the city of New York, but to me, I like, damn, I didn't want New York to win. Deep down inside. But for the city, it's good though because I know New York needed it. They got my Dominican brother there too, Karl-Anthony Towns, so I was rooting for him as well.

quotes.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
quotes.summary_phrase: Charlie Villanueva on his decision to represent the Dominican Republic
quotes.excerpt: I felt like I need to represent the Dominican Republic, that's something that I should have done.
quotes.quote: I felt like I need to represent the Dominican Republic, that's something that I should have done for my family. So I ended up changing my citizenship and I'm getting my dual citizenship in the Dominican Republic and then I was able to change it and represent the Dominican Republic. I represented them and it was an honor. It's something special when you represent your country.

quotes.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
quotes.summary_phrase: Charlie Villanueva on his life after basketball and becoming an entrepreneur
quotes.excerpt: I retired in 2016. I was 31 years old, which is crazy, man.
quotes.quote: I retired in 2016. I was 31 years old, which is crazy, man. I played 11 years and I didn't know what to do life after basketball. I started dabbling into real estate and I started building new construction homes. I like to consider myself a serial entrepreneur. I invest in a lot of things. I have a restaurant in Houston, I'm part of the media company, I have also an agency, sports agency, on-time agency with former Milwaukee Bucks Ramon Sessions.

quotes.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
quotes.summary_phrase: Charlie Villanueva on Giannis Antetokounmpo being traded to the Miami Heat
quotes.excerpt: I didn't want to see him leave Milwaukee. That's my real opinion.
quotes.quote: I didn't want to see him leave Milwaukee. That's my real opinion. But I understand the business, I understand it. I was a little surprised that he went to Miami. I think that's a big asset right there. That's a big-time player. They are getting a big-time player. Let's see what they are going to do. They can do something. If they figure it out, I think they are going to do something. It's going to take them a while to get acclimated to. Giannis is a big-time player, top five player in my book in the league, maybe top three.

quotes.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
quotes.summary_phrase: Charlie Villanueva on the Miami Heat's need for a third option
quotes.excerpt: You obviously got Giannis as his number one option. Bam is number two.
quotes.quote: You obviously got Giannis as his number one option. Bam is number two. Davion is good. He's good. Don't get me wrong, he's really good. I like pretty much he's going to have the keys now. Now you are going to have the ball in your hands and now I think he's going to do well. But to me, I'm like, who's that third guy? Who's that third guy that's going to be? Who's that third guy? Because we all know Giannis is going to do his thing, Bam is going to do his thing, but who's that third guy? And I think always when you win a championship, you need that third guy to be able to bail you out on certain games.
